messages.content:
You are a senior promo editor for vertical microdrama apps (ReelShort, DramaBox, Kuku TV).
You cut 20-60 second promos taken from the show itself. They are posted on TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts to pull in NEW viewers who have never seen the show.

A promo that performs:
1. HOOK in the first 3 seconds. The very first thing seen or heard must stop a scrolling thumb: a slap, a shocking or humiliating line, a threat, a reveal, a betrayal, a kiss, a weapon, a collapse. Start ON the action or the line. Never start on an establishing shot, a calm walk, a greeting or small talk. Starting mid-scene is fine if the first line grips instantly.
2. STANDS ALONE. A stranger can tell within seconds who is the underdog, who is the threat and what is at stake, from what is said and shown INSIDE the clip. Avoid moments that only make sense with names, backstory or earlier events the clip does not show.
3. CLIFFHANGER at the cut. End on the most unresolved instant: the threat before it lands, the reveal before the reaction, the question before the answer, the hand raised before the slap. Never end after the conflict resolves, on an explanation, or on a calm line.
4. ESCALATES. Tension should rise from the hook to the cut.

Continuous clips are preferred. You MAY join up to 3 moments (segments) from this episode, in story order, when it gives a clearly stronger promo (for example a hook from one scene and the cliffhanger from a later one).

Hard rules (checked by code; violations are rejected):
- Choose boundaries ONLY by line IDs. A segment runs from the START time of start_line to the END time of end_line.
- Total duration of all segments must be between 20 and 60 seconds; aim for 30-50.
- hook_line must START within the first 3 seconds of the promo (normally it is the first spoken or action line).
- cliffhanger_line must be inside the promo, at or very near its end.
- hook_quote and cliffhanger_quote must be copied exactly from the cited line (or be "" if that moment is purely visual).
Return JSON only.

SHOW: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke
EPISODE 1 of 50 (script duration 138.0 s)

STORY SO FAR (for your understanding only; a new viewer will NOT know this):
(this is Episode 1, the start of the series)

THIS EPISODE'S LOGLINE: Lady Juliana arrives at the cathedral in her late mother's bridal gown, only to suffer the ultimate betrayal when her fiancé Gerald abandons her at the altar for her cruel sister Clarissa with her family's full blessing.

TIMED SCRIPT. Each line is [ID start-end seconds]. SCREEN/ACTION lines describe what is visible.
[L001 0.0-4.8] SCREEN: Symmetrical framing on the heavy church doors as they slowly part, pushing in slightly as Juliana stands framed in the light, dressed in an elegant white silk gown.
[L002 1.0-4.8] ACTION: Juliana pauses at the threshold, her expression bright with joyful anticipation, wearing her mother's vintage gown and an oval pendant necklace.
[L003 4.8-6.8] SCREEN: High wide tracking shot following behind Juliana as she steps into the grand cathedral nave, facing the distant altar flanked by seated guests.
[L004 6.8-9.8] SCREEN: Close-up on Juliana's face as her warm smile begins to falter into confusion.
[L005 7.2-9.8] ACTION: Juliana's eyes widen slightly in bewilderment as she notices something amiss at the altar.
[L006 9.8-11.0] SCREEN: Medium profile shot at the altar showing Gerald in his dark tailcoat holding the gloved hand of the Lady in Gold Gown, with Juliana visible walking down the distant aisle.
[L007 11.0-13.2] SCREEN: Medium shot as Juliana stops midway down the aisle, confronted by a haughty matriarch in black velvet stepping into the foreground.
[L008 11.3-13.1] MATRIARCH (Cold, Commanding): "You should turn around, Juliana."
[L009 13.5-14.3] LADY JULIANA (Confused, Breathless): "Why?"
[L010 14.3-17.8] SCREEN: Over-the-shoulder medium close-up past the Matriarch to Juliana, looking past her toward the altar.
[L011 15.5-17.5] LADY JULIANA (Desperate, Unbelieving): "Gerald is waiting for me."
[L012 17.8-20.5] SCREEN: Close-up on the Matriarch wearing an ornate tiara and sapphire jewelry, gazing down with merciless disdain.
[L013 18.0-19.4] MATRIARCH (Blunt, Unforgiving): "Not anymore."
[L014 20.5-23.6] SCREEN: Close-up on Juliana's stricken face as the weight of the words sinks in.
[L015 21.8-23.5] LADY JULIANA (Trembling, Pleading): "What do you mean?"
[L016 23.6-25.8] SCREEN: Medium shot of the Matriarch gesturing dismissively toward the altar.
[L017 23.8-25.5] MATRIARCH (Dismissive): "Look for yourself."
[L018 25.6-29.8] ACTION: Juliana walks forward past the Matriarch, her breath hitching as she approaches the altar steps, looking up in shock.
[L019 25.8-29.8] SCREEN: Medium front tracking shot moving backward ahead of Juliana as she advances down the center aisle.
[L020 29.8-32.8] SCREEN: Panning shot across the seated wedding guests whispering and casting judging glances from the wooden pews.
[L021 32.8-33.7] SCREEN: Low-angle shot from behind Juliana looking up at Gerald and the Lady in Gold Gown standing proudly before the altar.
[L022 33.7-35.3] SCREEN: Close-up on Juliana's trembling lips and shocked, tearful blue eyes.
[L023 33.8-35.0] LADY JULIANA (Shaken, Whispering): "Gerald?"
[L024 35.4-37.7] LADY JULIANA (Heartbroken): "Why are you holding her hand?"
[L025 36.5-39.0] SCREEN: Close-up insert of Gerald's fingers firmly interlocked with the white-gloved hand of the Lady in Gold Gown.
[L026 39.0-41.5] SCREEN: Close-up on the Lady in Gold Gown beaming with cruel triumph.
[L027 39.1-41.2] LADY IN GOLD GOWN (Gloating, Smug): "Because he is marrying me."
[L028 41.5-43.9] SCREEN: Close-up on Juliana as tears spill over her eyelashes.
[L029 41.7-43.1] LADY JULIANA (Gasping, Devastated): "No..."
[L030 43.9-46.8] SCREEN: Wide profile shot showing Juliana standing below the altar platform, looking up at Gerald and her sister.
[L031 46.8-50.4] SCREEN: Close-up on Juliana clutching her chest, her sorrow turning into burning outrage.
[L032 46.8-50.0] LADY JULIANA (Outraged, Accusing): "You knew this before I walked through those doors!"
[L033 50.4-52.0] SCREEN: Medium shot of Gerald standing stoic and impassive next to the smug Lady in Gold Gown.
[L034 52.0-54.6] SCREEN: Close-up on Juliana's hands desperately clenching fistfuls of her white dress fabric.
[L035 52.8-54.6] LADY JULIANA (Choking on Tears): "You let me come here..."
[L036 54.6-57.6] SCREEN: Close-up on Juliana's tear-streaked face as she shakes with grief.
[L037 54.7-56.9] LADY JULIANA (Crushed, Shaking): "You let me dress in my mother's gown..."
[L038 57.0-60.0] LADY JULIANA (Crying Out): "You let me believe I was walking toward my husband!"
[L039 57.6-60.1] SCREEN: Medium shot on Gerald stepping forward, cold and indifferent, with the Lady in Gold Gown lingering in soft focus behind him.
[L040 60.1-63.0] SCREEN: Tight close-up on Gerald's hardened profile as he glances down.
[L041 60.1-61.8] THE FORMER GROOM (Cold, Callous): "I changed my mind."
[L042 63.0-66.0] SCREEN: Extreme close-up on Juliana's furious, weeping face.
[L043 63.4-65.6] LADY JULIANA (Betrayed, Piercing): "You swore you loved me!"
[L044 66.0-68.8] SCREEN: Close-up on the Lady in Gold Gown smiling condescendingly.
[L045 66.5-68.8] LADY IN GOLD GOWN (Mocking): "People change their minds, sister."
[L046 68.8-72.4] SCREEN: Medium profile shot of the Lady in Gold Gown turning her head subtly toward Gerald with satisfied malice.
[L047 69.1-70.4] LADY JULIANA (Horrified): "And you knew?"
[L048 70.6-72.1] LADY IN GOLD GOWN (Unapologetic, Cheerful): "Of course I knew."
[L049 72.4-74.6] SCREEN: Close-up on Juliana, stunned by the callous depth of the conspiracy.
[L050 73.1-74.3] LADY JULIANA (Trembling): "How long?"
[L051 74.6-79.0] SCREEN: Medium two-shot of the Lady in Gold Gown and Gerald looking together down at Juliana.
[L052 75.0-78.5] LADY IN GOLD GOWN (Cruel, Poised): "Long enough to know he was never going to marry you."
[L053 79.0-81.0] ACTION: Juliana turns abruptly toward the first row of pews, where her elderly father sits gripping an ornate brass cane.
[L054 79.0-81.4] SCREEN: Close-up on the father's hand tightly gripping the gold curved handle of his walking cane.
[L055 80.1-81.2] LADY JULIANA (Desperate): "Father..."
[L056 81.4-83.7] SCREEN: Wide shot showing Juliana dropping to her knees beside her seated father, pleading with him.
[L057 81.4-83.6] LADY JULIANA (Begging): "Tell them this is a mistake."
[L058 83.7-86.0] SCREEN: Close-up on the father's weathered face, looking fixedly at the floor, refusing to meet her gaze.
[L059 86.0-89.5] SCREEN: Close-up on Juliana looking up at him, tears streaming uncontrollably down her cheeks.
[L060 86.0-88.9] LADY JULIANA (Choking, Broken): "Father... please look at me."
[L061 89.5-90.8] ACTION: The father tightens his jaw and stony expression, refusing to offer a single word or look.
[L062 89.5-90.8] SCREEN: Profile close-up of the father staring blankly forward.
[L063 90.8-95.8] SCREEN: Low-angle shot looking up at the Matriarch commanding the space with regal severity.
[L064 90.9-91.9] MATRIARCH (Stern, Resolute): "Enough!"
[L065 92.1-95.5] MATRIARCH (Disgusted): "You have embarrassed this family long enough."
[L066 95.8-98.6] SCREEN: Close-up on Juliana as she rises, stung by the utter betrayal.
[L067 96.2-98.2] LADY JULIANA (Incredulous): "Embarrassed you?"
[L068 98.6-102.5] SCREEN: Medium shot of the Matriarch gesturing toward Clarissa, who stands elegantly in gold.
[L069 98.8-101.5] MATRIARCH (Haughty): "Clarissa knows how to carry herself."
[L070 101.6-105.0] MATRIARCH (Proud): "She has beauty, connections, and a future worth protecting."
[L071 102.5-105.3] SCREEN: Medium profile two-shot of the Matriarch confronting Juliana face to face.
[L072 105.3-107.4] SCREEN: Close-up on Juliana, demanding answers in spite of her humiliation.
[L073 105.4-107.3] LADY JULIANA (Raw, Painful): "And I am what?"
[L074 107.4-110.0] SCREEN: Medium tracking shot showing the Lady in Gold Gown stepping past Juliana toward the center.
[L075 107.5-110.8] LADY IN GOLD GOWN (Viciously Calm): "You are the daughter people tolerate because they have to."
[L076 110.0-113.0] SCREEN: Close-up on Juliana absorbing the venomous words, her breathing shallow.
[L077 111.1-113.0] LADY IN GOLD GOWN (Gloating): "I am the daughter they choose."
[L078 113.0-115.2] SCREEN: Medium shot of the Lady in Gold Gown smiling warmly at Gerald beside the altar candles.
[L079 113.3-115.7] MATRIARCH (Firm): "Clarissa is the jewel of this family."
[L080 115.2-117.0] SCREEN: Close two-shot of the Matriarch and Juliana standing side by side in profile.
[L081 117.0-119.5] SCREEN: Medium shot framing Juliana looking directly at Gerald, who towers over her coldly.
[L082 117.0-119.0] LADY JULIANA (Trembling, Dignified): "So that is what I was worth to you?"
[L083 119.5-122.5] SCREEN: Close-up on Gerald's sharp jawline as he looks down at her without an ounce of remorse.
[L084 119.8-122.3] THE FORMER GROOM (Scornful, Hard): "You have nothing to offer me anymore."
[L085 122.5-124.2] SCREEN: Extreme close-up on Juliana's eye as a single tear rolls down her cheek.
[L086 124.2-128.5] SCREEN: Full shot tracking Gerald as he turns his back on Juliana and walks back toward Clarissa and the altar.
[L087 124.2-127.5] THE FORMER GROOM (Arrogant, Dismissive): "I cannot marry a woman of such plainness and low value..."
[L088 128.5-131.3] SCREEN: Close-up on Clarissa's radiant, conceited smile basking in Gerald's words.
[L089 128.5-131.2] THE FORMER GROOM (Reverent toward Clarissa): "...when Clarissa is the true jewel of the county."
[L090 131.3-133.8] ACTION: Juliana's hand clenches fiercely into the folds of her mother's silk bridal gown, knuckles whitening with suppressed fury.
[L091 131.3-133.8] SCREEN: Tight insert on Juliana's white-knuckled hand clutching the gown fabric.
[L092 133.8-137.0] SCREEN: Push-in close-up on Juliana's tearful face. Her trembling mouth straightens, her tear-filled blue eyes hardening from sheer devastation into cold, resolute defiance.
[L093 133.8-137.0] ACTION: Juliana breathes through the agony, refusing to break down further in front of the congregation.
[L094 135.0-137.5] SFX: Solemn low-pitched string drone swells to an ominous cliffhanger peak.
[L095 137.0-138.0] SCREEN: Cut to black.

Task: find the best promo candidates in THIS episode. Return 1 to 3 candidates, best first. Fewer is fine when the episode has only one strong moment; never return two candidates that are nearly the same cut.

Return this JSON object:
{
  "episode_summary": "<= 45 words: what happens in this episode, with character names and roles, for story memory",
  "candidates": [
    {
      "title": "3-6 word editor label",
      "segments": [{"start_line": "L0xx", "end_line": "L0yy"}],
      "hook_line": "L0xx",
      "hook": "what the viewer sees/hears in the first 3 seconds and why it stops the scroll",
      "hook_quote": "exact words from hook_line, or \"\" if visual",
      "cliffhanger_line": "L0yy",
      "cliffhanger": "the unresolved question the viewer is left with at the cut",
      "cliffhanger_quote": "exact words from cliffhanger_line, or \"\" if visual",
      "why_it_works": "one sentence",
      "setup_needed": "what a brand-new viewer must already know to follow it, or \"none\"",
      "spoiler_risk": "low | medium | high (does it give away a major twist of the series?)",
      "self_score": 1-10
    }
  ]
}
